name: digital-tracking-system-for-municipal-waste-management
description: Digital Tracking System for Municipal Waste Management - MERN Stack College Project

scripts.install-all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.build: npm --prefix client install --include=dev && npm --prefix client run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.cpSync('client/dist', 'dist', {recursive:true});"
scripts.vercel-build: npm --prefix client install --include=dev && npm --prefix client run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.cpSync('client/dist', 'dist', {recursive:true});"

author: Municipal Waste Management Team
